cards.title: 9th International Conference on Prevention & Infection Control
cards.organization: ICPIC — International Consortium for Prevention & Infection Control
cards.whyThisHotel: YOTEL Geneva Lake (Founex, Vaud) offers 237 rooms and six flexible meeting spaces (up to about 250 delegates) with hybrid facilities and an airport shuttle. Secondary accommodation block or small ancillary meeting only — the main congress is committed to CICG in central Geneva and historic official hotels are city-centre. Founex needs a dedicated transfer plan; do not present as an easy congress base. Inference: airport-corridor accommodation plus six meeting spaces and hybrid facilities suit selected groups, subject to Founex-to-CICG transfer acceptance.
cards.nextStep: Contact Lara Schneider, copying icpic.reghot@mci-group.com, to confirm the named 2027 housing procurement lead and whether additional suppliers or small groups are being considered. Offer a targeted Founex room-block/side-meeting proposal only after confirming block size, dates including shoulder nights, rate/commission requirements, selection timetable and willingness to fund CICG transfers. Use Mathias Guilloux as the operational alternative and Jan von Hildebrand only for sponsor-side referrals. Qualify the lodging path first — do not pitch a block or assume overflow.
